holdings.name: Sansera Engineering Ltd

what_changed.text: Shareholders approved a dividend of Rs. 4 per share at the 44th Annual General Meeting on September 24, 2026.
Goldman Sachs raised its target price on the stock as the company reached fresh record highs in September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Sansera Engineering is the fund's largest holding at 4.82% and contributed an estimated +1.351% over 3 months with a 28.02% return.

watch.text: Watch sales and margin durability after revenue reached Rs 1,021 crore in June 2026.

holdings.name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd

what_changed.text: The company acquired 100% of the integrated diagnostic business undertaking of Arya Wellness Centre in Guwahati, Assam.
Axis Direct assigned a Buy rating to the stock in October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.10% weight, Vijaya Diagnostic is the fund's second-largest stock and a primary contributor to its 20.3% Healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Watch the financial integration of the Arya Wellness Centre business into existing diagnostic operations.

holdings.name: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd

what_changed.text: The company completed its merger effective July 1, reporting FY26 revenue of Rs 9,273 crore at its AGM.
Purana Housdurgam Vijayadeepti retired from the board and Neela Bhattacherjee was appointed independent director on September 28, 2026.
Hospital stocks including Aster DM experienced broad sell-offs in October 2026.

expected.text: Motilal Oswal initiated coverage on Aster DM Healthcare with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 910 on September 28, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Aster DM Healthcare carries a 4.07% portfolio weight and detracted an estimated -0.722% over 3 months following a -17.75% stock decline.

watch.text: Watch net profit recovery after earnings declined to Rs 29 crore in June 2026 from Rs 94 crore in June 2025.

holdings.name: Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved acquiring a 51% stake in Sarvottam Health Care for up to Rs 80 crore by October 31, 2026.
The company approved acquiring up to a 22% stake in Splendid Hospitals for up to Rs 40 crore by March 31, 2027.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.30% weight, KIMS reduced fund returns by an estimated -0.482% over 3 months after a -14.61% price drop, compounding healthcare sector weakness.

watch.text: Watch the completion of the 51% acquisition of Sarvottam Health Care targeted for October 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Kalpataru Power Transmission Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL upgraded the company's long-term rating to AA+/Stable from AA on October 16, 2026.
The company won Rs 2,225 crore in transmission and distribution orders on October 13, 2026.
Swedish subsidiary LMG completed an IPO and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm in late September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.58% weight in Industrials, Kalpataru posted a 4.15% 3-month return, providing a positive offset against healthcare holdings.

watch.text: Watch execution on the order book after FY27 total inflows reached Rs 13,219 crore.

holdings.name: Minda Corporation Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved a fundraise of up to Rs 500 crore via NCDs and issued Rs 100 crore in commercial paper.
The company executed share subscription agreements to acquire 26% stakes in Agganga and Sunsure Solarpark Sixteen.
The company invested Rs 18 crore to purchase additional shares in subsidiary Spark Minda-Toyodenso.

holdings.why_it_matters: Minda Corporation represents 2.39% of the fund, pairing with top holding Sansera Engineering to form a core automotive ancillary basket in Consumer Discretionary.

watch.text: Watch the utilization of the approved Rs 500 crore debt issuance.

holdings.name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: The company scheduled a board meeting for October 26, 2026, to review Q2 and H1 FY2027 financial results.

expected.text: Dolat Capital established a target price of Rs 700 on September 29, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Five-Star Business Finance holds 2.10% of the portfolio and detracted an estimated -0.194% over 3 months amid a -9.25% share price decline.

watch.text: Watch Q2 and H1 FY2027 performance and asset quality indicators from the October 26 board meeting.

holdings.name: Century Plyboards (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: The company inaugurated a Rs 215-crore greenfield plywood manufacturing plant in Hoshiarpur, Punjab.
Management stated that company debt has peaked and profitability is expected to strengthen.
CRISIL raised Century Plyboards' ESG rating to 62 from 51, upgrading it to Strong.

expected.text: The company targets Rs 600 crore in revenue from its new Punjab facility and aims to reach zero debt by FY27.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.08% weight, the stock fell -15.44% over 3 months, deducting an estimated -0.321% within the Materials sector.

watch.text: Watch Q2 and H1 FY2027 unaudited results during the board meeting scheduled for November 4, 2026.
Watch the operational ramp-up of the Hoshiarpur unit toward its Rs 600 crore revenue target.

holdings.name: Ajanta Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: The company called a board meeting for October 30, 2026, to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY2027 financial results.
The company scheduled an earnings conference call for the second quarter of FY2027.

holdings.why_it_matters: Ajanta Pharma has a 2.05% weight and forms part of the fund's 20.3% Healthcare exposure, recording a modest -2.64% return over 3 months.

watch.text: Watch the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on October 30, 2026, for margin trends.

holdings.name: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Ltd

what_changed.text: ICRA reaffirmed the company's AA/Stable and A1+ credit ratings on Rs 3,282 crore of facilities.
Director James Raymond Trout resigned, and Aninda Chatterjee was appointed as an Independent Director.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.92% portfolio weight, Techno Electric detracted over medium and long horizons, falling -8.46% over 3 months and -29.51% over 1 year.

watch.text: Watch revenue momentum after quarterly sales dropped to Rs 630 crore in June 2026 from Rs 1,010 crore in March 2026.

portfolio.statement: Kotak Small Cap Fund generated a 3-month return of -1.18% and a 1-year return of 2.96% with an AUM of Rs 19,141 crore.
interp: Gains from auto ancillary and engineering holdings like Sansera Engineering were overshadowed by drawdowns in major hospital positions.
The fund maintains high concentration across Healthcare (20.3%), Industrials (19.6%), and Consumer Discretionary (17.8%).
portfolio.line: Healthcare detractions countered engineering and auto ancillary outperformance over the quarter.

drivers.text: Sansera Engineering led gains with a 28.02% 3-month return following record revenue and a Goldman Sachs target raise.
Aster DM Healthcare and Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences declined -17.75% and -14.61% amid industry-wide hospital stock sell-offs.
Kalpataru Projects accumulated new orders worth Rs 2,025 crore and Rs 2,225 crore, supporting the industrial basket.

themes.title: Hospital and Diagnostic Concentration
themes.text: The fund commits over 13% of its capital across hospital and diagnostic chains experiencing short-term profitability pressure and stock corrections.

themes.text: Consumer discretionary holdings are scaling operations through debt raises and capital expenditure.

macro.why: Net income fluctuations and operational integrations directly impact hospital valuations.
holdings: Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Ltd

macro.why: Transmission and distribution project flow determines order inflows and revenue visibility.

priced_in.text: High forward growth expectations are priced into Sansera Engineering and Vijaya Diagnostic Centre at P/E multiples of 72.06 and 75.90.
Strong execution expectations are reflected in Kalpataru Projects after FY27 inflows reached Rs 13,219 crore.

could_change.title: Hospital Earnings Recovery
could_change.text: If net profit margins stabilize after June 2026 declines at Aster DM Healthcare and KIMS, healthcare drag on the fund could abate.

could_change.title: Industrial Inflow Translation
could_change.text: Accelerated conversion of Kalpataru Projects' Rs 13,219 crore order inflows into revenue could strengthen industrial contributions.

portfolio.risk_note: Healthcare comprises 20.3% of the portfolio, where high-multiple holdings like Aster DM Healthcare (P/E 163.99) and Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences (P/E 148.57) face earnings pressure.
